question: As of October 2020, who is the Director General of the World Trade Organization?
solution:
The correct option is__** Roberto Azevedo.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Roberto Azevedo** was born on **3 October 1957**, is a **Brazilian career diplomat**.
 
• He had served as** Director-General** of the **World Trade Organization (WTO)** from **2013 until 2020**.
 
• Since** 2020**, he has been **Executive Vice President **and** Director of Corporate Affairs at PepsiCo**.
 
• He succeeded** Pascal Lamy** as Director-General of the** World Trade Organization **in** May 2013**. 
 
• On **14 May 2020**, he announced that he would resign as the** Director-General of the World Trade Organization on 31 August 2020**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• WTO **(World Trade Organization) **was formed on** 1 January 1995**.
 
• The WTO is headquartered in** Geneva, Switzerland**.
 
• **Peter Sutherland**
 
 
• ​He was an Irish businessman, barrister and Fine Gael, politician.
 
• He was the **1st Director General of WTO**, serving from **July 1993** to **May 1995**.
 
• He is also known as the** Father of Globalization.**
 
 
 
• **Arthur Dunkel**
 
 
• Arthur Dunkel **(26 August 1932 – 8 June 2005)** was a Swiss (Portuguese-born) administrator.
 
• He served as** General Agreement on Tariffs and Trade Director-General **between **1980 and 1993**.
 
 
 
• **Pascal Lamy**
 
 
• Pascal Lamy is a French political consultant and businessman.
 
• He was the **Director-General of the World Trade Organization** from **1 September 2005** to **1 September 2013** for 8 years.
